transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, I must point out that you are overreacting. It is not my fault that the jar was knocked over. As for the cauldron, it was only used for a simple mixture to soothe my throat. The storeroom is far from a state of disarray, and I assure you that it will be perfectly organized in time for the inspection.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Overreacting? Overreacting, you say? Severus, look around you! There's powdered moonstone dusting my rare Bezoar collection, a half-eaten Fizzing Whizbee stuck to the top of my best retort, and is that... is that a *spiderweb* on my pristine silver scales? A simple mixture, you say? Your 'simple mixtures' always leave an aroma that lingers for weeks! And the pineapple, Severus! The Minister's own! Do you know how hard it is to get crystallized pineapple of that calibre? It's not about being "perfectly organized" in time, it's about *respect* for the order I had established!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see. It appears that you have let your sentimentality overrule your common sense, Slughorn. A single jar of pineapple, no matter who gave it to you, is not worth the outburst. The Bezoars were not damaged by the moonstone, and a Fizzing Whizbee is easily cleaned off. As for the scales, they require a polish every month regardless. I assure you, everything will be in its place before the inspection. If you have concerns, I suggest you prioritize the actual issues, rather than manufacturing them.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Sentimentality, Severus? You call the Minister's personal gift mere sentimentality when it's spilled all over my worktop? And a Fizzing Whizbee "easily cleaned"? It's *sticky*, Severus! Sticky! This is my reputation on the line, not some trivial student assessment! The Potions Guild expects meticulousness, not... not *haste* to put things right at the last possible moment!

You promised to keep this place tidy! You *know* how important this inspection is for my sabbatical application! Now I have two hours to fix *this* mess and somehow pretend that everything has been in impeccable order all week! This isn't manufacturing issues, Severus, this is a catastrophe of your making!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I repeat, Slughorn, it is not my making. The room was tidy when I left it this morning, and I assure you that the...
It seems we are at an impasse. Let us not waste time with further arguments. There are two hours until the inspection. If you wish to take the lead in organizing the storeroom, you may do so. I will simply ensure that the cauldron and the items I have touched are returned to their original state. It is clear that we cannot work together in this situation.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Not your making"? Severus, are you quite serious? Are you suggesting the pixies came in and spilled the pineapple and smeared the Fizzing Whizbee? You were the last one in here! And you think I have time to 'take the lead' when I'm meant to be preparing my presentation on advanced potion stabilization?

No, Severus, we are not at an impasse! We are staring down an imminent disaster that *you* seem determined to contribute to! You promised to help! Now you're just going to tidy *your* mess? The whole room is a mess! The Potions Guild doesn't care whose individual items are out of place, they care about the *entire storeroom*! This is outrageous! Absolutely outrageous!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Slughorn, I am well aware of the importance of the entire storeroom, and it is precisely for that reason that I am not engaging in a fruitless argument with you. We have two hours to prepare, and your emotional state is not conducive to efficient work. If you would prefer to allocate your time to further berating me rather than addressing the actual issue at hand, then be my guest. I will proceed with tidying the room to the best of my ability without your assistance. It would be best if we simply... divide and conquer.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Emotional state"? My emotional state is a direct result of *your* disregard, Severus! And you think "divide and conquer" is going to work when you've just admitted to only tidying *your* part of the mess? That's not dividing, that's abandoning! I need *help*, not excuses and condescension!

Do you have any idea how bad this will look? My career, my reputation, my sabbatical... all because of a lack of basic tidiness and a shattered jar of pineapple! This is insufferable! Just insufferable! You are supposed to be a colleague, not a... a saboteur! Now, are you going to help me restore some semblance of order to this chaos, or are you just going to stand there and lecture me about my "emotional state"?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your volume is not helping, Slughorn. I have no desire to engage in a screaming match. If you would like my assistance, I am willing to provide it. However, I will not be insulted or shouted at in the process. We have a task to complete, and we must do so without further... distractions. I suggest we focus on the work at hand. If you can specify which areas require the most immediate attention, I will prioritize them accordingly.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
My volume is a direct result of the *mess*, Severus! And your sudden willingness to help, after all this blustering and arguing, is truly remarkable. Very well, if you're quite finished with your... *observations* on my state, perhaps you can be genuinely useful for once.

The priority is the main worktop! Get that pineapple cleaned up, immediately! And then, for Merlin's sake, put that Fizzing Whizbee in the waste bin – don't just leave it to harden! After that, the shelves with the bottled ingredients look like they've been ransacked. Straighten them, and check the labels for consistency. I'll tackle the scales and the Bezoars. Move! We haven't a moment to lose!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I will address the worktop and the shelves as you have directed. However, I must remind you that the scales and Bezoars are not as simple to... "tackle" as you seem to think. If you require assistance with either of those, do not hesitate to ask. We are, after all, colleagues – regardless of our personal... differences. Now, if you will direct your focus to the task at hand, we can avoid any further... delays.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Colleagues," yes, Severus, a concept you seem to struggle with at times. I assure you, I am perfectly capable of handling my own scales and my own Bezoars, thank you very much. I've been polishing them long before you were even a twinkle in your mother's eye! Just focus on the task I've given *you*. The pineapple! And the shelves! And try not to break anything else! Just focus!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your ... confidence is noted, Slughorn. I will proceed with the tasks you have assigned. If you require any... guidance with your own work, I am available. However, I must remind you that the Bezoars require careful handling to avoid cross-contamination. As for the scales, I would suggest using a cleaning solution with a neutral pH to prevent any... unexpected reactions. Now, if you would permit me to return to the matter at hand, we have a limited amount of time in which to achieve a result that will satisfy the Potions Guild.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Oh, Severus, your 'guidance' is as welcome as a Niffler in a jewellery shop. I am perfectly aware of the precise care required for both Bezoars and silver scales. I practically *invented* the neutral pH cleaning solution for alchemical metals! I hardly need a lecture from you, thank you very much!

Just focus on that sticky mess and those shelves! Make sure everything is aligned perfectly, and for Merlin's sake, put those volatile ingredients back in their proper, labelled compartments. Don't go 'improving' my system, just *follow* it! We have to make this place look like nothing ever happened, and your... *suggestions* are only slowing us down!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As you wish, Slughorn. I will not offer unsolicited advice. However, if you do encounter any... difficulties, do not hesitate to seek my assistance. I assure you, I am well-versed in the proper care of magical ingredients and alchemical materials. Now, if we are to complete this task in a timely manner, it would be best to avoid further... distractions. I will attend to the worktop and the shelves as you have instructed. If you require additional hands, I am here to... help.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good. Just... just get on with it, Severus. Focus on the pineapple and the shelves. And don't worry about my "difficulties," I assure you, my expertise is quite sufficient for my own tasks. Just ensure your assigned areas are immaculate, and perhaps we can salvage this inspection yet. No more distractions, indeed. Just *work*.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Agreed. We shall proceed in silence, as is often best. I will tend to the areas you have specified, and you to your... own concerns. Let us hope that this... collaboration, however strained, will yield a result that meets the exacting standards of the Potions Guild. I will not disappoint, and I trust you will not either. Now, let us waste no further time in... accomplishing our respective tasks.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Silence? Hmph. A welcome change, I must say. Though I doubt it will last. Just... just get it done, Severus. Make sure every single bottle is perfectly aligned, every label facing forward, and not a speck of that blasted pineapple left anywhere. We simply *cannot* afford any more... *surprises*. My reputation depends on it, and I'd prefer not to be humiliated by the Guild, especially not on your account. Now, let's see some actual *progress* for once!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand the... gravity of the situation, Slughorn. Your reputation is, indeed, on the line. Rest assured, I will not... undermine your efforts. I will ensure that every bottle is in its precise location, every label facing forward, and the worktops spotless. There will be no... surprises. I suggest you apply the same... rigor to your own work. Let us endeavor to present a united front to the Potions Guild, despite our... differences. Now, I will attend to the pineapple. You have your... scales and Bezoars. Let us... demonstrate our... professionalism.
